##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 27 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure near Iceland, weak warm front affecting the area.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 for a time tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy outbreaks of light rain or drizzle, becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 for a time, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.
